functional.name: Session and object-level access
functional.acceptance: An analyst can view only assigned customer records; a manager can view all records in this organisation; only an admin manages users. Anonymous and forbidden requests return 401/403 without object content.
functional.verification: API access matrix including direct-ID requests

functional.name: Customer records
functional.acceptance: Authorised users create, view and update a customer with a unique ID, display name and owner. Blank names fail validation and rejected updates leave stored data unchanged.

functional.name: Interaction capture
functional.acceptance: Enter or import JSON with customer ID, channel, timestamp and ordered speaker/text turns. Unknown customer, invalid timestamp, missing turn text and excess size produce per-record errors before persistence.

functional.name: Search and filters
functional.acceptance: Search by customer name and filter interactions by customer, channel, date and review state. Combining filters returns their intersection and shows a usable empty state.
functional.verification: API query tests and UI task

functional.name: Durable analysis job
functional.acceptance: For the same interaction revision and method/config version, repeated creation requests return one job. Status is queued, running, succeeded or failed. Bounded retry never overwrites a successful run.
functional.verification: Duplicate submission, worker crash and retry tests

functional.name: Analysis result with provenance
functional.acceptance: A completed run stores topic labels, an at-most-120-word summary, source-turn references, source hash, method/model/config version and creation time. Invalid references fail output validation.

functional.name: Human review
functional.acceptance: A reviewer inspects source and result side by side, edits the reviewed summary and approves or rejects it. The original output remains immutable and reviewer, timestamp and decision are recorded.

functional.name: Failure recovery
functional.acceptance: Failed jobs show an actionable error without customer text or secrets in the message. An authorised retry creates an attempt record and preserves prior failure history.
functional.verification: Timeout, unavailable model and malformed-output tests

functional.name: Export
functional.acceptance: Authorised export returns only accessible customer/interactions, both raw and reviewed results, provenance and review status. Empty selection produces a clear validation message.

functional.name: Run comparison
functional.acceptance: An experiment records dataset revision, baseline/candidate, configuration and metrics. An output table separates measured results from unexecuted targets.
functional.verification: Re-run using frozen inputs and manifest

functional.name: Overview
functional.acceptance: A manager sees counts by topic and review state from the same authorised filtered data. Counts reconcile with the underlying list.

functional.name: Additional source adapter
functional.acceptance: A second connector is added only after mandatory scenarios pass and data permission is documented.

nonfunctional.name: Confidential data
nonfunctional.acceptance: No secrets or real customer records in Git. Example configuration uses placeholders. External inference stays disabled unless a data-use decision permits it.

nonfunctional.name: Usability and keyboard access
nonfunctional.acceptance: Core review/import tasks work with keyboard only. Controls have labels and visible focus. At 390 px and 1440 px the primary workflow has no unintended page overflow.
nonfunctional.verification: Manual keyboard pass and browser checks

nonfunctional.name: API responsiveness target
nonfunctional.acceptance: On a documented 4-core/8-GB reference host and 10 concurrent users over 1,000 synthetic customers and 5,000 interactions, non-inference reads target p95 <= 500 ms over 200 requests after warm-up. Exclude network-to-model time and report it separately.
nonfunctional.verification: Load test with recorded host and request mix; target, not observed result

nonfunctional.name: Inference operational bound
nonfunctional.acceptance: With fixed model, host and inputs up to 2,000 words, report cold/warm p50/p95 latency, memory and failure rate. Set a 60-second job timeout and at most 2 automatic retries. No quality/latency pass is claimed before measurement.

nonfunctional.name: Reproducible runs
nonfunctional.acceptance: Every evaluation records code commit, dataset hash, method/model revision, prompt/config and environment. Non-deterministic methods report settings and run variability.

nonfunctional.name: Persistence and audit
nonfunctional.acceptance: Successful writes are durable across an app restart. Review changes preserve raw outputs. A backup/restore rehearsal reconciles customer, interaction and review counts.

nonfunctional.name: Input and output limits
nonfunctional.acceptance: API rejects interaction text above 2,000 words or 100 KB and imports above 100 records. Client rendering treats transcript/model output as text, not executable HTML.

nonfunctional.name: Review accountability
nonfunctional.acceptance: Only a human action sets approval. An algorithmic confidence value is not presented as a probability of correctness unless calibrated.
